commit.message:
gen_schema_index: merge into existing index instead of rebuilding from scratch

Old schema versions are only stored in GitHub release assets, not in the
working directory. Building the index from scratch would silently drop any
version not present on disk.

Load the existing index as the base and union in whatever is found on disk,
so previously-published versions are always preserved.

commit.message:
schemas: version per-schema rather than as a group

Previously all schemas shared a single version in their published URL
(e.g. schemas/v0.1/csr_schema.json), so any schema change would bump
the version for every schema file.

Now each schema has its own independent version. The published URL
becomes schemas/<schema_name>/<version>/<schema_name>, e.g.:
  schemas/csr_schema.json/v0.1/csr_schema.json

Only the schema(s) whose $id is bumped get a new release tag; all
others remain at their current version.

- resolver.rb: write to gen/schemas/<schema_name>/<version>/
- publish_schemas.rb: create per-schema release tags
- gen_schema_index.rb: index is now schemas -> [versions] per schema
- pages.yml: download from per-schema release tags
- pages.html.erb: render per-schema version history
- README.adoc: update URL examples

commit.message:
test: add unit tests for schema versioning changes in udb gem

Covers:
- Resolver#resolve_schemas: per-schema output layout, $id URL, skips
  json-schema-draft-07.json and schemas without $id, preserves fields
- TopLevelDatabaseObject#validate: bare and versioned $schema refs,
  SchemaValidationError on invalid data, schema cache hit path,
  no-$schema warning path, SchemaError on invalid schema file
- create_json_schemer_resolver: relative $ref lookup by basename,
  path-prefix stripping
